prdTicketRef: SCH-013 (PRD header). The pipeline ticket is SH-13.
brownfieldFindings: prisma/schema.prisma has no Conversation, ConversationParticipant, Message, MessageAttachment, MessageReport, MessagingSettings, MessageRevision or PendingMessageEmail models, no ReportStatus enum, and no User.isSafeguardingLead. All need one new migration plus back-relations on User and FileObject.

PRD-12 (Announcements) is NOT present in the workspace: there is no Announcement model, and artifacts/run-summary.json shows SH-12 with succeeded=false. PRD-13 only mentions announcements under Out of Scope, so this does not block messaging. Do not build announcements in this run.

Course has teacherId plus coTeacherIds String[]. 'A course the teacher manages' is read as teacherId OR coTeacherIds (MEDIUM). Section.homeroomTeacherId covers homeroom. Enrollment.status ACTIVE/DROPPED covers ended relationships. ParentStudentLink covers parent links.
The student detail route is src/app/(app)/students/[id], not [studentId]. Keep the existing segment name. The PRD forbids renaming routes.

Shared components live in src/components/<Name>/ (FileList, FileUpload, UserAvatar, UserPicker, ConfirmDialog, Toast, NotificationBell, EmptyState, PageHeader), not src/components/shared/. Reuse them where they are.
The maintenance run is POST /api/internal/email/dispatch (it already calls the quiz maintenance jobs). PendingMessageEmail processing hooks in there.
src/server/rate-limit.ts rateLimit(key, limit, windowMs) already exists. Use it for 30 messages/min/user.
src/server/files/access.ts registerFileAccess(context, resolver) already exists. The 'message' context registers through it.

src/server/auth/requireRole.ts exports requireUser/requireRole/requirePageUser/requirePageRole. Notification types are in src/server/notifications/types.ts, and the COMMUNICATION category already exists.

There is no admin user-management page under src/app/(app)/admin. The users API exists at src/app/api/users/[id]. 'Editable on the admin user form' means extending the existing user update validator/API, plus whichever form currently edits users (architect to locate).

functionalRequirements.description: Add Prisma models Conversation, ConversationParticipant, Message, MessageAttachment, MessageReport (+ ReportStatus enum OPEN/REVIEWED/DISMISSED) and MessagingSettings with the fields, relations, cascades and indexes given in the PRD.
Add isSafeguardingLead Boolean @default(false) to User, meaningful only for ADMIN and editable on the admin user form.
Add a MessageRevision model { messageId, body, createdAt } that stores the original body every time a message is edited.
Add a PendingMessageEmail table { userId, conversationId, dueAt } that drives deferred message emails.

Implement canMessage(sender, recipient) in src/server/messaging/contact-rules.ts using the full sender→recipient matrix (admin always; teacher↔admin/teacher; teacher→student/parent via ACTIVE enrollment in a managed course or homeroom section; student→own teachers/admin; parent→linked child's teachers/admin; student→student/parent and parent→parent/student never).

Creating a conversation requires canMessage(creator, each other participant) and a maximum of 25 participants. A group containing a STUDENT must include at least one TEACHER or ADMIN. Students in a staff-created group may reply but cannot start conversations with each other. On violation return 403 and create nothing.

Contact rules are re-checked on every send. If the relationship has ended, the non-staff party is refused and the composer shows 'You can no longer send messages in this conversation.' Staff can still send.

GET /api/messaging/contacts?q= returns only messageable users, grouped by labels such as 'My teachers', 'My child's teachers (<child>)', 'Students in <course>', 'Parents of students in <course>' and 'School office'.

Build the /messages inbox: two panes, collapsing to a single pane with back navigation below 768px. The conversation list is sorted by lastMessageAt and shows participant names or subject, a 'sender: text' preview, time and an unread badge. It has search by participant name/subject and Inbox/Archived tabs.

Build the message thread: sender avatar and name, timestamps grouped by day (school timezone), attachments via FileList, an 'edited' marker, deleted messages shown as 'This message was deleted', and upward infinite scroll at 30 messages per page.

Build the composer: textarea where Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a newline, up to 5 attachments with file context 'message', and a character counter shown after 4,500 characters (body is 1–5,000 chars).
Build the new-conversation dialog: multi-select recipient picker fed by the contacts endpoint, optional subject (max 120) and a first message.
Polling: the visible active thread polls GET /api/conversations/:id/messages?after=<lastId> every 5s. The conversation list and the sidebar unread badge poll every 30s.

Opening a thread updates lastReadAt. A per-conversation menu offers mute, archive/unarchive (per user), view participants, and leave group. The creator of a group that contains students cannot leave it.
Senders can edit or soft-delete their own messages within 15 minutes of sending. Later edits or deletes are refused. Users can never hard-delete a message.
Student page header actions: 'Message parents' (TEACHER/ADMIN) starts a group with the student's linked parents, and 'Message teacher' (PARENT) opens a picker of the child's teachers.
Add a 'Message selected students' action to the course roster (TEACHER).
Add a sidebar 'Messages' entry with an unread count for all roles in src/config/navigation.ts, backed by GET /api/messaging/unread-count.

Register notification type message.received (COMMUNICATION, default email true). On send, give each non-muted other participant one in-app notification per conversation, replacing older unread message.received rows for that conversation.

Send the message email only if the recipient has not read the conversation within 10 minutes and it is outside their quiet hours (deferred until quiet hours end). The maintenance run sends it from PendingMessageEmail.
Add a 'Quiet hours' section to /account/notifications (start/end HH:mm in the school timezone, may wrap midnight), stored in MessagingSettings via GET/PUT /api/me/messaging-settings.
Any participant can report a message with a reason (max 1,000 chars) via POST /api/messages/:id/report. The reporter sees 'Reported — the school will review this.'

Build the /admin/safeguarding Reports queue (ADMIN with isSafeguardingLead only, others get 403). Open reports come first, each with the message, context of 5 messages before and after, and participants. Actions: Mark reviewed (with note) and Dismiss.

Build the safeguarding Conversations search: lists conversations with involvesStudent = true, filterable by participant and date, with a read-only view that includes deleted content and the original text of edited messages.
Every safeguarding view of a conversation writes an audit entry 'safeguarding.conversation.view' via audit().
Register notification type message.reported (mandatory in-app, email true) and notify all safeguarding leads on each new report.
Register file-access context 'message': conversation participants and safeguarding leads may access attachments.

Implement the REST API listed in the PRD: conversations list/create/get, messages list (before/after)/send, message edit/delete/report, read/mute/archive/leave, unread-count, contacts, safeguarding reports and conversations, and me/messaging-settings. Use the standard response/error shapes and pagination.

functionalRequirements.description: Seed: Alice Admin is a safeguarding lead. Add conversations Pat↔Tom about Sam's homework (6 msgs), Tom→MATH-7A group of 4 students (3 msgs), Tina↔Tom staff chat (4 msgs), and one reported message in a student↔teacher conversation.
Conversation.involvesStudent is computed when the conversation is created (true if any participant is a STUDENT) and is used for safeguarding search.
Message send updates Conversation.lastMessageAt so list ordering and polling reflect new activity.

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Security: every messaging and safeguarding endpoint and server page checks participation, role or isSafeguardingLead on the server. Conversation cuids are never treated as authorisation.
Performance: polling endpoints respond in under 100 ms using the (conversationId, createdAt) index and return empty arrays when nothing changed.
Retention: users never hard-delete messages. Soft-deleted content and edit revisions stay available to safeguarding.
Rate limit: POST /api/conversations/:id/messages allows 30 messages/min/user and returns 429 RATE_LIMITED beyond that (reuse src/server/rate-limit.ts).

UI component rule: every visible element uses only MUI (@mui/material v9, icons-material, MUI X packages), looked up through the mui-mcp server (useMuiDocs/fetchDocs) before use. No banned libraries (Tailwind, shadcn, Radix, notistack, etc.). QA checks for banned imports and checks that every MUI import resolves to a documented component.

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Conventions: thin Zod-validated handlers (src/lib/validators/messaging.ts), services in src/server/messaging/, standard success/list/error response shapes, cuid ids, UTC storage with school-timezone display, and logger instead of console.log.

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Responsive: below 768 px the inbox switches to a single pane with back navigation.
Near-real-time: a message sent in one browser appears in another open thread within 6 seconds via polling. No websockets.
Scope guard: no voice/video, typing indicators, reactions, E2E encryption, websockets or broadcast messaging. Do not modify behaviour owned by later PRDs.

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Tests: unit tests for the full contact-rule matrix (groups, ended relationships); integration tests for notification collapsing, quiet-hours deferral and edit revision capture; Playwright parent→teacher round trip in two contexts and student→student block. The existing lint/typecheck/test suite stays green.
Mutations on records owned by someone else (e.g. safeguarding review of reports) write an AuditLog row via audit().

FR-1 conflicts with convention: Conversation, Message, MessageReport, MessageAttachment and MessagingSettings in the PRD's Prisma block lack updatedAt, while conventions say every model has createdAt/updatedAt. Should updatedAt be added?
FR-2: There is no admin user-management page in src/app/(app)/admin. Where should isSafeguardingLead be edited — an existing user edit form elsewhere, or only via PATCH /api/users/:id?
FR-5.1: Should quiet hours apply to all roles or only teachers? The user story mentions teachers, but the settings endpoint is open to any role.
PRD-12 dependency: SH-12 (Announcements) is not implemented in the workspace. Confirm messaging can proceed independently.
unresolved: FR-32 co-teacher scope — proceeding with teacherId OR coTeacherIds (MEDIUM).
updatedAt on new models — architect to decide. Default: add updatedAt per the platform convention. The PRD block is treated as the minimum field set.
Location of the isSafeguardingLead edit UI — architect to locate the existing user edit form. If none exists, extend the user update API/validator only.
Quiet hours role scope — proceeding with all roles (the settings endpoint is 'any').
PRD-12 absence — proceeding. Messaging does not depend on announcement code.
